title: Depth under input complementation
statement: For any set of available coordinates and any binary decision tree $T$ with those coordinates available, complementing the input bits leaves its depth unchanged: the complemented tree has depth equal to the depth of $T$.
hypotheses_covered: A set of available coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
A binary decision tree $T$ with that set of available coordinates
